title: Find Nuclei profiling descriptor (v1)
description: Descriptor for an extendedMeasurements entry of kind "profiling" in a run manifest. Documents per-well profiles (median per well, robust z against negative-control wells, feature selection) and compound activity (mAP for groups with replicates, distance from DMSO for single wells, Benjamini-Hochberg q-values). Points at three parquet tables beside it.
x-stability-note: UNSTABLE: this format is published for transparency and tooling, not as a stable contract. It is still converging alongside the Find Nuclei platform and may change without preserving backward compatibility until that ships. Pin a copy rather than assuming a descriptor that validates today will validate later.

kind.description: Matches extendedMeasurements.<id>.kind in the run manifest.

compartments.description: Compartments whose measurements were aggregated. Feature names are {compartment}__{column}.

channelRoles.description: Channel index (as a string) to stain role, e.g. {"0": "DNA"}. Empty when not set.

scale.description: MAD scale factor: z = (x - median_neg) / (scale * MAD_neg).

method.description: map: groups with 2 or more wells are tested by mAP, single wells by distance. distance: every group is tested by the mean distance of its wells against the leave-one-out negatives.

distance.description: distance_to_negative is the RMS of a well's robust-z vector over the kept features.

data.description: Tables beside this descriptor, as paths relative to it.

wellProfiles.description: well_id, compound, dose, control_type, n_cells, then the kept robust-z features.

wellActivity.description: well_id, compound, dose, control_type, n_cells, n_fields (fields of the well that produced measurements; null when the run records no fields), distance_to_negative, distance_p, ap.

compoundActivity.description: group, compound, dose, n_wells, map, p_value, q_value, active, mean_distance, test (map | distance | null).

warnings.description: Sentences for the user, e.g. too few negative-control wells to call single-well compounds active, or how many compounds must beat every negative well before any is called active.

relativePath.description: Relative path; no leading slash, no .. segments.
